status: post hoc relative to the original plan; written before any revision run; no external timestamp
margin_rationale: 5 pp is the pre-registered practical margin; it is also of the order of the static verifier's late impostor acceptance (0.068), so a smaller change in attacker acceptance would not alter a deployment decision.

analyses.R-OP: Operating point: CORE policies at fixed tau_acc (FRR at matched probe FAR 1/5/10%, per-run DET), and KEY policies with tau_acc re-selected after every (re)fit so that FAR on the public reference set equals 2/5/10%. Endpoints: online challenge rate (C0), realised late probe FAR, attack gain (C3). Tests: P-B0, B1c-B0, P-B1c challenge rate, Holm within target.
analyses.R-PRIM: Primary contrast: TOST (+-margin) on gain(P)-gain(B1) under C3; replication on 5 new partitions (seeds 5-9) and pooled 10 partitions; stronger attack C3s (40%, bursts x2) where B1 gain exceeds the MDE.
analyses.R-STEP: Step-up realism: attack gain, attacker admissions and genuine lock-outs for STEP_POL across p_att in P_ATT (p_gen=1) and p_gen in P_GEN (p_att in {0,0.05}), under C2 (natural, label-seeking) and C3 (crafted). Handover after sign-in with per-sample vs trust-window (G=10) labels. Selection-effect control B1c_audit5.
analyses.R-ATT: Attack suite: CORE policies under C3n (motor noise), C5 (gate-aware), C6 (generative), C3s (strong).
analyses.R-SF: Single-factor contrasts: B1c-B1 (silent admission), B3-B1 (gate, no DP), P-B2p (gate | DP, same budget+pacing), P-B3p (DP | gate, same schedule), B2-B1 (DP+budget); attack gain under C3, C3s, C5; Holm within attack.
analyses.R-PRIV: Participant- and record-level MIA on final adaptive models (C0); template recovery from leaked novelty statistics; update-log side channel AUC; composition across K=20 released models and utility at the population-calibrated sigma.
analyses.R-GEN: Random-Fourier-feature verifier (D=256, pilot-tuned); drift regimes (practice effect removed; matched-magnitude random walk); Touchalytics with the strong attack; analytic on-device cost.
